value.ews_detail: Amnesty 2025 (p.50, 67-68): community EWS since 2016 (eThekwini + UKZN); SAWS data + community reports; WhatsApp groups, whistles, ropes, evacuation map; ~30 min lead time; triggered 5 times by May 2025. April 2022: all residents evacuated, one death by electrocution (no drownings). Not yet replicated to the 180 high-risk settlements; nearest shelter 5km away.
